package_scope_note: Single-model export. GAP-set golden vectors and Model A (Subspace KNN) removed from scope. This POC targets only the original38 training distribution; no model in this project achieves both LOOCV>=80% and GAP>=80% (see docs/reports/MODEL_SELECTION_DECISION_CURRENT.md).

accuracy_note.explanation: Two distinct accuracy figures apply to this model and must not be conflated.
accuracy_note.loocv_estimate: 94.7% (36/38) - honest generalization estimate; each prediction made by a tree trained on the OTHER 37 samples, never seeing the held-out sample. loocv_held_out_prediction/loocv_held_out_correct fields below reproduce this per-sample.
accuracy_note.deployed_artifact_resubstitution: 100.0% (38/38) - the shipped artifact was refit on all 38 samples, so scoring it against those same 38 rows is a resubstitution/training-accuracy check, not a generalization test. model_predicted_class/model_probability_class1 fields below are this artifact's real, actual output for each row and are what the ESP32 port must reproduce exactly.
accuracy_note.l041_l085_note: l041.fsj and l085.fsj are the two LOOCV held-out errors (l041=FN, l085=FP). The deployed (refit-on-all-38) artifact predicts both correctly, since it was trained on them. This is expected resubstitution behavior, not evidence against the 94.7% LOOCV figure.
